canonical_title: System of Instruction and Workshop Design (Teacher-Centred vs Student-Centred)

one_line_answer.text: The system of instruction used will determine the design and organization of the workshop.

cites.quote: The system of instruction used will determine the type of design and organization of

bangla_explanation: কীভাবে পড়ানো হবে, তার ওপর workshop-এর design নির্ভর করে।
শিক্ষক-কেন্দ্রিক পদ্ধতিতে classroom আর workshop থাকে, সবাই একই বিষয় একসাথে শেখে।
শিক্ষার্থী-কেন্দ্রিক বা নিজের গতিতে শেখার পদ্ধতিতে প্রত্যেকে নিজের গতিতে এগোয়।
তখন একটা equipped workshop আর একটা আলাদা resource area লাগে।

example.en: In a CBT electrical course, trainees work at different tasks. Each reads the learning materials in the resource area first.
example.bn: Self-paced ক্লাসে একেকজন একেক task করে, তাই resource area লাগে।

short.prompt: How does the system of instruction affect the design of a workshop?
short.modelAnswer:
The system of instruction determines the design and organization of the workshop.
1. Teacher-centered: theory in a classroom with movable chairs and desks. About 2.5 square meters per student. Each student has a workspace. An area for group demonstration is needed.
2. Student-centered (self-paced): students progress independently. Needs an adequately-equipped workshop and a separate resource area.

keyPoints.text: The classroom allows approximately 2.5 square meters of space per student.

cites.quote: It is suggested that the classroom should allow approximately 2.5 square meters of
space per student.

cites.quote: This type of workshop needs to have a suitable area for group demonstration.

keyPoints.text: In self-paced learning, students progress independently of their peers.

cites.quote: Self-paced learning is a form of student-centered learning, as students progress through the course independently of their peers.
